About

A rapidly absorbed age-spot correcting hand cream containing patented Thiamidol to reduce the appearance of age spots and prevent reappearance with regular usage. Hand cream absorbs quickly, improves skin’s elasticity and moisturises for 24 hours. SPF 30 provides additional protection from future sun-induced age spots.
NART: 66875-09900-04

Read more about our product

Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream for reducing age spots The pigment melanin is produced by melanocytes that provides colour to skin and is our body’s own natural UV-protection. Yet increased melanin production and uneven distribution in our skin can cause age spots to occur. Many women start noticing age spots appearing naturally on their hands from the age of 50 onwards, commonly as result of accumulated sun exposure or due to their skin’s melanin formation type. To reduce the appearance of age spots and prevent their reappearance, we created Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age-Spot Correcting Hand Cream. The hand cream is well absorbed, leaves skin feeling noticeably firmer, and is also incredibly effective at moisturising the skin, so it feels comfortably nourished all day long. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream is made using a unique formula to deliver multiple anti-ageing benefits. Eucerin’s innovative blend of both high and low molecular Hyaluronic Acid visibly plumps deep wrinkles works alongside Arctiin, an active proven to accelerate collagen renewal in skin cells. It also contains Thiamidol, an effective and patented ingredient that acts at the root cause of hyperpigmentation by reducing melanin production. It is clinically and dermatologically proven to reduce dark spots and prevent their re-appearance. First results are visible after two weeks and improve continuously with regular use. With UVA and UVB filters (SPF 30) the correcting hand cream offers effective protection from the sun and minimises the chances of skin developing sun-induced pigment spots. Age spots on the hands are visibly reduced and skin appears even and radiant.

Clinical Formula

Arctiin (Arctium Lappa)

Arctiin is a naturally-derived active ingredient extracted from the fruit of the Burdock plant with anti-inflammatory  and anti-aging properties. 

Arctiin strengthens the connective  tissue by increasing the production of  the main extracellular matrix components collagen and hyaluronic acid as well as  inhibiting the degradation of elastase.  Additionally, Arctiin has anti-inflammatory properties. 

Learn More
Thiamidol

Thiamidol is a patented ingredient, known to fight hyperpigmentation acting at its root cause. It works by inhibiting the human tyrosinase, the key enzyme in melanin production. Hyperpigmentation can be the result of different causes, e.g. sun-induced dark spots, post-blemish marks or age spots. Key benefits are:

Reduction of Hyperpigmentation: By effectively inhibiting tyrosinase, Thiamidol decreases melanin synthesis, leading to a visible reduction in dark spots and an even skin tone.

Works on all skin types: Thiamidol is dermatologically tested and suitable for all skin types, including dry, oily, combination, normal and sensitive skin. It works for skin of any ethnicity or age and thus is effective on all skin types and tones.

Fights post-blemish marks: Post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation happens when skin is inflamed or injured, for example because of blemishes. The impacted area is left darkened and hyperpigmented despite having otherwise healed. Thiamidol addresses these areas resulting in an even skin tone.

FAQ

You can apply Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream SPF 30 to your hands up to four times a day only as it contains the active ingredient Thiamidol. Avoid contact directly on or near your eyes.

Can I use this product for visible age spots on my hand?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream SPF 30 visibly reduces the appearance of age spots and prevents their reappearance.

Can I use this product to prevent age spots from reappearing?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream SPF 30 is made with the active ingredient Thiamidol to help prevent spots from reappearing.

Is this product suitable for mature skin?

Yes. Eucerin Hyaluron-Filler + Elasticity Age Spot Correcting Hand Cream SPF 30 is suitable for all adult skin.
